annotation.title_clean: Projeto regulamenta uso da inteligência artificial no Brasil
annotation.title_en: Bill regulates the use of artificial intelligence in Brazil
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agência Câmara de Notícias (Câmara dos Deputados)
annotation.summary_en: Chamber of Deputies news item (May 2025) on Senate-approved Bill PL 2338/2023, now before the Chamber, which regulates AI in Brazil through risk classification. It bans excessive-risk systems, including autonomous weapons, and restricts facial recognition in public spaces. It also covers copyright remuneration for AI training data.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI systems classified by risk to life and fundamental rights; generative and general-purpose AI require preliminary risk assessment
Excessive-risk systems banned, including autonomous weapons that select and attack targets without human intervention
Bans on CSAM-generating systems and predictive crime profiling based on personality traits
Real-time facial recognition in public spaces allowed only in limited cases with judicial authorisation
Copyrighted works used for commercial AI training entitle rights holders to remuneration; non-commercial research exceptions
